story.title: Company Overview
story.p1: Pure Environment for Renewable Energy is a leading company in the renewable energy sector, specializing in providing innovative and effective solutions in solar energy. The company was founded with the aim of providing clean and sustainable energy solutions that contribute to environmental protection and cost reduction for its clients.
story.p2: Pure Environment for Renewable Energy is one of the subsidiaries of Tal Holding Group, which has great diversity in its sectors, such as agriculture, commerce, and industry. Through this affiliation with the group, the company is committed to providing high-quality solar energy solutions, benefiting from diverse expertise across various sectors to provide innovative solutions that meet the needs of local, regional, and international markets.
story.p3: Pure Environment for Renewable Energy seeks to facilitate the transition to renewable energy and provide effective solutions for clients across various sectors, including homes and large companies. Thanks to our advanced technologies and specialized team, we ensure the delivery of solar energy systems that achieve high efficiency and economic savings in the long term.

solar.title: Solar Panels
solar.subtitle: Latest high-efficiency solar panel technologies
solar.description: We provide the best types of solar panels from major global companies, which are characterized by high efficiency in converting solar energy into electrical energy. Our solar panels feature a long lifespan and high resistance to various weather conditions.

inverters.title: Inverters
inverters.subtitle: High-quality inverters to convert DC to AC
inverters.description: We provide a wide range of solar inverters that convert DC current from solar panels to AC current for residential and commercial use. Our inverters feature high efficiency and excellent reliability.
features: Compatible with all types of solar panels

cables.title: Solar Cables
cables.subtitle: Specialized cables for solar systems
cables.description: High-quality cables specifically designed for solar systems, featuring high resistance to UV rays and high temperatures. Our cables ensure safe and efficient energy transmission.

structures.title: Steel Structures
structures.subtitle: Strong and durable structures for solar panel installation
structures.description: Engineered metal structures designed to withstand all weather conditions and securely mount solar panels. We use the best types of galvanized iron resistant to rust.
